_doc: MISUMI HFS6-3030: a 30 x 30 mm aluminium extrusion of its 6 series, clear anodised (HFSB6-3030 is the same section in black). Dimensions, area, second moments and mass are from MISUMI's catalogue page. The drawn outline leaves out the fillets where webs meet the core. MISUMI prints no section modulus or torsion constant.

material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

lengths.rule: Fixed length parts (KHFS6-3030): 1000 and 4000 mm (4000 is the effective length)
lengths.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-571, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_571.pdf

cut_length_min.rule: Configurable length, from 50 mm in 0.5 mm steps
cut_length_min.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-571, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_571.pdf

cut_length_max.rule: Configurable length, to 4000 mm (6000 for some, by special order)
cut_length_max.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-571, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_571.pdf

cut_tolerance.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-569, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_569.pdf

straightness_per_metre.rule: Bend: 0.3 mm or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 mm (this section's is 42.4 mm), which is 1.00 mm in a metre. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
straightness_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

twist_per_metre.rule: Twist: 1/2 degree or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 to 76 mm (42.4 mm here), at most 5 degrees over the whole length. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
twist_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf
